- Priority B (mid-market, high intent): GridPath, AltaCloud — watched >50%, visited pricing page.
- Priority C (early-stage / low activity): assorted registrants.

2) Demo credits: Ben — can you confirm whether we have 1x demo-credit approval for DataVista? They specifically asked for a 45min privacy/ops demo with infra questions.
3) Replay push: Marissa — can you push the replay + short 1-pager to Priority A and B within today (email + 1 LinkedIn touch)?

For external: Tara — thanks for joining. I shared your note with my sales team; someone will reach out to set a demo. Replay link is attached.

Thanks — simple, fast follow-up will keep momentum.

— Lauren
